svg.aria-label: repohelix co-change atlas: files arranged on a ring with chords whose weight encodes temporal-coupling strength
svg.title: repohelix: co-change atlas (nebula fixture)
svg.desc: Files on a ring; each chord links two files that changed together in the synthetic nebula history. Heavier, straighter chords mean stronger temporal coupling. Strength is a Jaccard-style ratio of shared commits.
